result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't try a renamed-aspect config.

The change is in `exportJson` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The code now goes through the main, test, generated, build-and-deploy and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that writes the loose text files. It then reads that file and uses the same name as the zip entry.

With the default config the entries are unchanged: `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, `aspect_other.txt`, in that order. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written when a `git-history.txt` exists.
